claims.statement: For any subfamily A of the rank-491 matching sector with 736 two-vertex color classes, its union D(A) of one-element deletion targets satisfies 491|A| <= 492|D(A)|. For the full level, the source-to-target ratio is 492/491 and the source-minus-target cardinality is exactly one 492nd of the source level.
claims.scope: CB(8,92) matching sector formed after fixing and stripping the central root and an arm leaf; only deletions retaining those two vertices are counted. The bound does not cover insertion arcs, competing demands, or the complete ordinary-tree aggregate.
claims.reason: retained: independent incidence counting gives 491 deletion incidences per source and at most 492 extensions per target; exact binomial recomputation confirms both level sizes and the integer shortfall. The source claim is valid at its stated sector-only scope, but supplies no mixed-boundary or aggregate conclusion.

limitations: The audit certifies only the colored matching-sector deletion boundary; hub-insertion capacities and competing demands remain unexamined.
No full selected-tag Hall inequality or complete favorable-leaf aggregate proof or refutation was established.
